method_boundary.actual_video_review: Each candidate below was downloaded as the original normal-speed YouTube MP4 and visually reviewed from unmodified source frames. The fps metadata was used only to confirm normal-speed source playback; it was not used for timing, distance inference, or any numeric speed result.
prohibited_inputs_not_used: video-derived time, distance, T90, 30m, 50m, FPS, or numeric rating
stolen-base technique, baserunning judgment, defensive range, or batting-result inference
